templates.label: Release checklist
templates.content:
# Release checklist

- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit
- [ ] npm test
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] cargo check -p talos-gui
- [ ] git diff --check
- [ ] AppImage built and checksummed
- [ ] Offline socket/resource check repeated
- [ ] Installed copy checksum matches
